stem: The newsletter team tags some links with utm_medium=Email and others with utm_medium=email. The stakeholder sees the newsletter's sessions split across two rows in a session source / medium breakdown, and asks what is going on. What do you explain?

options.text: The capitalised rows match no channel rule, so those sessions went to Unassigned instead
GA4 merges the two spellings after 48 hours, so the split goes away in the reports on its own later
UTM values are case sensitive, so two spellings make two rows; one spelling in every link fixes it
Auto-tagging rewrote one spelling, because a medium on a newsletter link cannot be set by hand
